overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance data clearly highlights that high-concept space and 'What If' hypothetical scenarios generate the strongest velocity in views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes-per-view) over the recent 7-day window. Specifically, extreme planetary conditions, bizarre cosmic phenomenons, and thought experiments ('What If You Fell Into...') outperform generic psychological or standard animal facts. Space-themed 'What If' videos published late September (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y, YlDuGu1vzAg, 8KEl0_pJ_68) dominate the top tiers of recent traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (YlDuGu1vzAg) drove the highest view counts (800-1000+ views) and strong like ratios compared to older or standard fact formats.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space scenarios involving extreme physical environments or bizarre planetary properties.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing surreal planetary weather or characteristics—such as 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U)—consistently pull high engagement and views.
winning_patterns.action: Continue sourcing bizarre, lesser-known real exoplanets and cosmic oddities with counterintuitive physics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, r43-7nSn8SQ) and 'Songs Stuck in Your Head' (Jc04LVKNd2s) stagnate below 20-50 views with negligible engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard human psychology trivia unless framed through an extreme, high-stakes hypothetical or mystery lens.

weak_patterns.pattern: Standard Animal Trivia without a Twist
weak_patterns.evidence: Simple declarative animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (AXAfwrzzEdU) yield moderate views but lower velocity and engagement than space content.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content toward cinematic animal survival or high-concept evolutionary anomalies rather than basic textbook facts.
